claims.claim: An international team examined images of 36 craters in Mars’ northern polar region taken by the HiRISE camera on NASA’s Mars Reconnaissance Orbiter from 2006 to 2025.
claims.episode_span: An international team examined images of 36 craters in Mars’ northern polar region taken by the HiRISE camera on NASA’s Mars Reconnaissance Orbiter from 2006 to 2025.
claims.supporting_quote: the researchers analyzed images of 36 craters within the northern polar ice cap region of Mars

claims.claim: Thirty-two craters showed changes in bright deposits that track seasonal frost growth and retreat.
claims.episode_span: Thirty-two craters showed changes in bright deposits that track seasonal frost growth and retreat.
claims.source_title: Martian Polar Crater Ice Shifts with Seasonal Frost
claims.supporting_quote: In the end, the researchers found that 32 of the 36 craters exhibited changes in bright deposits, broadly indicating ice deposits are expanding and shrinking with the seasons.

claims.claim: The fully stacked Starship stands 407 feet tall and generates 18.1 million pounds-force of liftoff thrust from 33 Raptor engines on the Super Heavy booster.
claims.episode_span: The fully stacked Starship stands 407 feet tall and generates 18.1 million pounds-force of liftoff thrust from 33 Raptor engines on the Super Heavy booster.
claims.supporting_quote: packs 33 Raptor engines, which burn liquid methane and liquid oxygen to generate 18.1 million pounds-force of booster thrust

claims.claim: Researchers noted that only a subset of craters show altered frost conditions relative to previous years while others maintain similar extents.
claims.episode_span: Researchers noted that only a subset of craters show altered frost conditions relative to previous years while others maintain similar extents.
claims.supporting_quote: only a subset of craters show altered frost conditions relative to previous years, while others maintain similar or nearly identical frost extents
